Marta (Sales): Lyra Freight wants a 3-week POC next month. Need a compact plan for sandboxes, data redaction, and trial pricing (hosted vs short dedicated). Can we confirm owners?
Ibrahim - Solutions: Success criteria suggestion: 1) p50 < 500ms for 300-token prompts; 2) support 4 concurrent editors; 3) retrieval F1 >= 0.8 on their 3k sample; 4) no PII in retained logs. Recommend two eval suites: 100 retrieval + 50 rewrite prompts.
Clara (AM): Customer will supply a 3k JSONL export in us-east-1. Prefers cross-account S3 read role with CMEK. Also asked for audit log delivery to their bucket.
Devon SRE: Fastest path: presigned PUTs into our intake bucket (same-day). Cross-account role needs trust policy + security review (~48h). For redaction we need their PII taxonomy and any regex they want enforced.
Hao - Eng: We'll run a 7B quantized model, enable KV prefix caching and warmup. I'll deliver a baseline latency/cost sheet within 48h.
Marta (Sales): Procurement asked for delta: hosted trial est $2k-$4k; short dedicated (monthly) $12k-$20k. Exact quote pending finance.
Devon SRE: Logs: keep encrypted metadata for 30 days; prompt bodies hashed unless customer opts in. We can export audit logs to their S3 with SSE-KMS.
Ibrahim - Solutions: Blockers: 1) InfoSec signoff on redaction rules (owner: Lyra + Devon), 2) S3 access method decision (owner: Clara), 3) spend cap & billing contact (owner: Marta), 4) model approval (owner: Hao).
ops-bot: sandbox project `lyra-eval-1895` created and queued awaiting S3 confirmation.
Marta (Sales): OK I'll send checklist + request sample and PII taxonomy. Intake call planned for tomorrow 9am PT. If no objections we'll proceed. :white_check_mark:
